items.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: So Marian and I played on that concert for them, and talked to them and did a little mini clinic.

ctx.x: Marian McPartland I think has been involved in some of those things. Have you ever gotten to meet her?

Yes. We worked together, as a matter of fact we put on a women’s seminar for young women at the IAJE conference last year in Chicago. And it was the professional women doing a seminar and concert for the young women, the students, both high school and college that were there. So Marian and I played on that concert for them, and talked to them and did a little mini clinic. She was wonderful. She moved so slowly to the piano, I was worried that maybe she was not feeling well or feeling tired or whatever. When she…

You have pretty wide ranging tastes in music I think, by listening to your CDs. There’s still some classical elements you throw in there. And I’m not sure I have this — maybe I should just start over on this one. I wanted to play the very beginning of this one tune because I thought it was pretty neat.
